verdict.rationale: Document text extraction is a fair question for a hosted data-extraction platform like Apify, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents extracting text from PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint files. XLSX export of datasets is an output format, not document ingestion, and the generic Actor marketplace count names no document-parsing Actor.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself
